_comment: CLASS-CONTENT.md sections 2 and 3 (defaults set 2026-10-26 09:20; owner questions Q54, Q55; every number TUNE), built
into NjordlingerCombatGameplayOverhaul.esp by tools/PluginBuild as PERK records: a class's ability, a title's
ability and each rank perk. No scripts. Effect kinds:
{av, add, if}  a constant self ability (Value Modifier on actor value av, +add) carried by the perk; 'if' = conditions
on the effect (run on the player).
{ep, mult|add, if}  a perk entry point (Mutagen's EntryType name) that multiplies or adds; 'if' conditions name
their tab: 0 the perk owner (default), 1 and 2 the entry point's other tabs in the game's order
ModIncomingDamage: 1 attacker, 2 attacker weapon; ModSpellCost / Magnitude / Duration: 1 spell;
ModIncomingSpellMagnitude: 1 caster, 2 spell; ModArmorRating: 1 armour; ModPickpocketChance: 1 target).
Conditions: {f, op ('==' default), v (1 default), tab, kw (a Skyrim.esm keyword editor ID), skill, hand ('right'/'left'),
or (true = OR with the next)}. 'approx' says where the effect is a near reading of the design line; 'stub' says what
is NOT built (the perk exists, named, and does only what its effects list) - listed in the report and PLAN.md.
